text: Taslima Nasrin's Lajja was published in 1993 and the Bangladeshi government banned it that year, on the grounds that it had "created misunderstanding between communities". The ban was publicly protested by many writers and human rights activists, and was seen as a sign of the growing influence of religious extremists.
